plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and build cash.

conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, holding a larger cash buffer for stability. Drawdowns should be minimal.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to manage leveraged ETF risk.

balanced.read: This plan targets around 2.5% per month by balancing growth and risk. It reduces concentration and leverage while adding new, strong setups. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase SOXL and SPAL to 6% each to leverage strong semiconductor trends.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for maximum growth. It increases leverage and concentration in high-conviction, high-scoring setups. Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to remove leveraged ETF risk.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month through distributions. It prioritizes income-generating assets like QQQI and reduces volatile single stocks and leverage. While aiming for low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
